relistening_evidence.observation: Bridge percussion drops out at 94.5s for an upbeat snare pickup directly into Verse 2 ('Engineers talking shit' at 95.0s), followed by an abrupt pause and punchy vocal inflection on 'Fuck it, I'll do it live' at 101.0s over isolated sub and dry hi-hats.

The vocal cadence trails off hesitantly on 'what kind of doc ta...' at 179.8s before an isolated, high-register shout 'DOCTOR?' strikes at 180.8s, triggering an eerie phaser/flange modulation on the instrumental as 'voodoo changes things' begins.
